findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0309: References to Reused Initialization Vectors in Symmetric Encryption
findings.explanation:
AES-GCM decryption uses a constant all-zero 12-byte nonce. Reuse of nonce with a fixed key breaks GCM. Scope is the test-asset override path, which lowers impact.
app/src/main/java/com/protonvpn/android/utils/AssetManager.kt:64: Static zero IV for GCM.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0212: Use of Hardcoded Cryptographic Keys in Code
findings.explanation:
A fixed HMAC-SHA256 key is hardcoded in source and used to build a SecretKeySpec.
app/src/main/java/com/protonvpn/android/vpn/ServerPing.kt:48: Hardcoded PING_KEY constant used as the HMAC key.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0242: Missing Certificate Pinning in Network Security Configuration
findings.explanation:
No pin-set in a network security config. Pinning may be done in code (OkHttp CertificatePinner, a custom TrustManager), which Ward doesn't read. MASVS L2 expects pinning; L1 doesn't.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:54: networkSecurityConfig @xml/network_security_config

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0254: Dangerous App Permissions
findings.explanation:
Dangerous (runtime) permissions requested. Check that each is needed for a feature, and that a weaker one (coarse instead of fine location, foreground instead of background) would not do.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:29: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0224: Usage of Insecure APK Signature Version
findings.explanation:
Signature scheme needs the built APK. Note the release build type is signed with the debug signing config.
app/build.gradle:338: Release uses debug signing config.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0288: Debugging Symbols in Native Binaries
findings.explanation:
The build keeps debug symbols for native libraries; the binaries must be inspected to confirm.
app/build.gradle:414: Debug symbols kept for all .so files.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0368: Insufficient Obfuscation of Security-Relevant Java/Kotlin Code
findings.explanation:
R8 minification is on for release, but whether the result is sufficient needs mapping and APK review.
app/build.gradle:337: Release build type has minification enabled.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0216: Sensitive Data Not Excluded From Backup
findings.explanation:
Backup is on (android:allowBackup="true") and there are no backup rules (dataExtractionRules, fullBackupContent), so every app file goes into cloud backups and device transfers.
release_tests/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:24: android:allowBackup="true"
